description.zh:
实例ID。
> 当本参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，还需要传入**NodeId**参数。
description.en:
The instance ID.

> If this parameter is set to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify the **NodeId** parameter.

description.zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 > 查询结束时间距查询开始时间不得超过24个小时，超过则调用失败。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time is in UTC.

> The end time can be up to 24 hours later than the start time. Otherwise, the call fails.

description.zh:
关键字搜索的逻辑操作，
默认值为and。
description.en: The logical operator for the keyword-based query. Default value: `and`.

description.zh:
分片集群实例中Mongos节点ID或Shard节点ID。

> 当**DBInstanceId**参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数才可用。
description.en:
The ID of a mongos node or shard node in a sharded cluster instance.

> This parameter is available only when the **DBInstanceId** parameter is set to the ID of a sharded cluster instance.

description.zh:
按时间的升降序对查询到的运行日志进行排序。取值：
- asc：按时间升序排序。
- desc：按时间降序排序。
description.en:
The sort order of the running logs to return. Valid values:

- asc: ascending order

- desc: descending order

description.zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**。
description.en: The page number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: **1**.
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **30** to **100**.

description.zh: 查询关键字，多个关键字以空格分隔，不超过10个关键字。
description.en: The keywords for the query. You can specify up to 10 keywords. Separate multiple keywords with spaces.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh: 节点的角色ID。您可以通过[DescribeReplicaSetRole](~~62134~~)进行查询。
description.en: The role ID of the node. You can call the [DescribeReplicaSetRole](~~62134~~) operation to query the role ID.

description.zh:
实例中节点的角色。取值：
- **primary**：主节点。
- **secondary**：从节点。

> 当**NodeId**参数传入的是Mongos节点ID时，**RoleType**取值只能为**primary**。
description.en:
The role of the node. Valid values:

- **primary**: The primary node.

- **secondary**: A secondary node.

> If the **NodeId** parameter is set to the ID of a mongos node, the **RoleType** parameter can only be set to **primary**.
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time is in UTC.

descriptions.zh:
- 本接口适用于规格类型为**通用型本地盘版**、**独享型本地盘版**和**云盘版**实例。
- 本接口限制每分钟调用30次，如超过这个限制会被限流，请勿高频调用。如需高频调用，请使用Logstore，详情请参见[管理Logstore](~~48990~~)。
descriptions.en:
- This API is for instances with the following specification types: **general-purpose local disk**, **dedicated local disk**, and **cloud disk**.

- This API is limited to 30 calls per minute. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, so avoid high-frequency calls. For high-frequency operations, use Logstore. For more information, see [Manage Logstore](~~48990~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-running-log-records --db-instance-id dds-bpxxxxxxxx --node-id d-bpxxxxxxxx --start-time 2019-01-01T12:10Z --end-time 2019-01-01T13:10Z --db-name mongodbtest --role-type primary --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --order-type asc --resource-group-id sg-bpxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx --role-id 651xxxxx --query-keywords test_test2 --logical-operator and --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dds DescribeRunningLogRecords --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime '2019-01-01T13:10Z' --PageSize 30 --ResourceGroupId 'sg-bpxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' --QueryKeywords test_test2 --RoleType primary --LogicalOperator and --StartTime '2019-01-01T12:10Z' --RoleId 651xxxxx --OrderType asc --DBInstanceId 'dds-bpxxxxxxxx' --PageNumber 1 --NodeId 'd-bpxxxxxxxx' --DBName mongodbtest
